name: Kawasaki KZ1000P Police
engine: 1015 cc air-cooled DOHC inline four, four carbs, high-output alternator
intro: The long-running Kawasaki police bike. Tough engine. Fleet wear and hacked police wiring are the usual trouble.

add.title: Check the police wiring
add.instructions: Trace any leftover radio, siren and light wiring. Remove what isn't used and check for melted connectors.
add.reason: Ex-police wiring is often cut and spliced, and it causes battery drain and shorts.

recallNote: Any recalls on bikes this old were closed long ago.

known.title: Charging and wiring
known.what: The alternator, regulator/rectifier and hacked police wiring are the classic weak points.
